method: Independent observations from the actual approved canonical PNGs, before any FigureSpec. Original SVGs were neither opened nor converted.
sourceApproval: D810 raw PNG/SVG and boundary PASS reused through D822's retained affected-source PASS. This is new modern-figure planning, not a source-page rereview.

groups.description: Two side-by-side subfigures: the left source panel is labelled Cyrillic small a; the right is labelled Cyrillic small be. Neither is an independent coordinate plot.
factsVerified: Both panels belong to one original figure.
Panel identifiers are not field vectors or quantities.
modernAdditions: English panel labels a and b, only after the edition text uses the same references.

groups.description: Left panel: ten visible parallel vertical field-line traces across the ring plane, with arrowhead-like features above it. Their vertical extents vary and traces are interrupted or occluded around the loops.
groups.positionUnits: Source pixels; inventory locators, not final geometry or given dimensions.
groups.plannedObjectPattern: fig99-a-axial-01 through fig99-a-axial-10, plus each arrow endpoint and direction marker
groups.unresolved: The coarse arrowhead silhouettes are not assigned a certified upward/downward direction in this inventory. Do not use prose-derived expected handedness as pixel evidence.

groups.description: Three nested closed elliptical-looking loops surround the axial traces in the left panel. The inner, middle and outer loops share an apparent center and horizontal projection plane. Direction-marker silhouettes appear on near and far portions; line breaks and occlusions must not become extra terminals.
groups.unresolved: Exact direction-marker tip orientation and exact dashed-versus-occluded segmentation remain unverified. No arrow direction has been invented.
modernAdditions: A regularized elliptical projection could be deterministic, but is a modern layout decision, not a source-measured ellipse.

groups.description: B above and right of the axial-line group; a partly clipped E label at the left edge near the ring plane; positive-change condition Delta B / Delta t > 0 below.
groups.unresolved: The clipped E glyph is recorded as partly clipped, not certified as a complete legible source letter from these pixels.

groups.description: Right panel: ten visible parallel vertical field-line traces cross the ring plane, including a near-right-boundary trace; arrowhead-like features occur above the plane.
groups.positionUnits: Source pixels; inventory locators, not final geometry or given dimensions.
groups.plannedObjectPattern: fig99-b-axial-01 through fig99-b-axial-10, plus each arrow endpoint and direction marker
groups.unresolved: No certified axial arrow direction is assigned from the degraded silhouettes.

groups.description: Three nested closed elliptical-looking loops surround the right panel's axial traces. Near/far direction-marker silhouettes are present, and portions are interrupted around crossings.
groups.unresolved: Exact near/far marker directions and dashed-versus-occluded segmentation remain unverified.

groups.description: E above the right panel's axial lines; B left of its loop plane; positive-change condition Delta E / Delta t > 0 below.

routing.basis: Field-line loops, direction markers, parallel traces, and symbolic conditions are typed mathematical schematic content; no natural-object artwork is needed.

groups.description: A rectangular U-shaped conductor goes from the upper capacitor lead up to the upper horizontal run, across to the left vertical run, down, then across the bottom run to the lower capacitor lead. The capacitor gap is not bridged by this conductor.

visibleDirectionMarkers.observation: A left-facing arrowhead-like silhouette is visible; retain as a source observation pending final direction inventory.

visibleDirectionMarkers.location: Left vertical run above B loops
visibleDirectionMarkers.observation: A direction-marker silhouette is present; do not invent polarity.

visibleDirectionMarkers.location: Bottom horizontal run near its middle
visibleDirectionMarkers.observation: Right-facing current arrow is visible in the bottom detail crop.

groups.unresolved: All three direction markers must be given definite endpoint bindings before a spec. Only the bottom arrow direction is treated as resolved here.
modernAdditions: Right-angle regularization is permissible only as a distinct modern geometry choice, not a measured source dimension.

groups.description: Three nested closed elliptical-looking B loops surround the left vertical conductor. A B label is above and left of this set. Arrowhead-like silhouettes occur on loop portions.
groups.unresolved: Exact circulation-marker direction and visibility segmentation are not certified.

groups.description: Two separated broad trapezoidal projected plate faces at the right: the upper face has its rear edge near y=114 and front edge near y=183; the lower face extends to a front edge near y=278. No plus/minus charges are drawn. The upper lead visibly enters the upper face; the lower lead starts just below the lower face's front edge.
groups.unresolved: The small visual gap between the lower lead and plate edge must not be silently closed as a pixel-certified connection. Resolve the intended topological attachment against complete D830 text and retain the visual occlusion/gap distinction.
modernAdditions: Deterministic simplified plate projection may improve readability, but must be explicitly distinguished from source dimensions.

groups.description: A dense group of near-vertical E field-line traces with direction-marker silhouettes occupies the plate gap. Some intersect and are occluded by the three B loops and plate outlines. E is labelled to the right.
groups.unresolved: The exact trace count and each trace's visible occlusion path remain unresolved; no ten-line or other guessed substitute is authorized.

groups.description: Three nested elliptical-looking B loops are drawn in the capacitor gap around the axial E group. A second B label is left of the capacitor gap.
groups.unresolved: Do not certify the circulation direction or crossing order from expected Maxwell handedness instead of the source pixels.

groups.description: A small italic I-like glyph is visible at the lower-left corner beside the bottom conductor; the bottom-detail crop distinguishes it from the middle-of-wire arrow.
groups.unresolved: The glyph is recorded as I-like rather than silently promoted to a different letter or numeric quantity.
